2609.22455.title: Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts
2609.22455.paper_summary: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of P.Herc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.
2609.22455.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Apollo Restore，一個擁有240億參數的大型語言模型，用於修復片段化的古希臘文本中的空白——即物理缺口。Apollo Restore 從 Mistral Small 微調而來，並採用填補中間的目標，能夠在不需要知道缺失部分長度的情況下重建缺失的片段。據我們所知，它是第一個針對歷史希臘語的大規模解碼器模型，也是第一個針對任何古地中海語言的模型。根據以往的研究評估，在長度不超過十個字符的短缺口中，Apollo Restore 能夠將正確的修復結果置於其前二十個候選中，對於文獻紙草、文學紙草和石刻缺口的正確率分別為 80.6%/54.6%/61.0%，超過了最強已發表模型的 $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$。然而，以往的評估協議因對於顯而易見的短缺口存在偏見而抬高了分數；在長度平衡的指標下，Apollo Restore 相較於最強已發表模型的優勢增長至 $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$，即使在給予錯誤長度提示的情況下也能穩定下降。在一項盲測中，20位專業的紙草學家、銘文學家和語言學家強烈偏好 Apollo Restore，並認為其表現至少與人類修復在77%的案例中一樣好。Apollo Restore 還改善了 P.Herc. 1667 的已發表讀本——這是一卷在公元79年維蘇威火山爆發中碳化的紙草卷，並在 Apollo Restore 的訓練數據編輯完成後進行了數位展開和編輯。Apollo Restore 是解碼古代倡議的產物，該倡議旨在為歷史語言和手稿構建專門的 LLM，由奧地利科學院主導。
